This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin and hair. At least one member of this species was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]]<ref name="Dark Times" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Intro">The date of this story is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In San Francisco, on Nineteenth Street, the was a zoo exhibition flag that had two lemurs on it, which George saw. He called Fay [David] right away and said, 'I saw a poster with a lemur. It'd be a good idea to build a character up from there.'|Sang Jun Lee|<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
[[File:LemurMaquette-RobertEBarnes-TaoRotS.png|right|200px|thumb|Maquette modeled by Robert E. Barnes for ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]
This species was first designed by concept artist [[Sang Jun Lee]] under the title "Lemur Concept 11" for the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], though the concept would go unused,<ref name="Art of" /> later recycled in [[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]] illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]]<ref name="Dark Times" /> and published on [[July 18]], [[2007]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54078/star_wars_dark_times_2006_4|text=Star Wars: Dark Times (2006) #4}}</ref> This was one of only a few "Lemur Concepts" chosen to receive maquettes molded by [[Robert E. Barnes]], who stated they were a particular challenge as the goal was to take a creature that was traditionally cute and give it a certain edge.<ref name="Art of" />
